caseName: Leroy v. Great Western United Corp.
caseNameFull: Leroy, Attorney General of Idaho v. Great Western United Corp.

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 439 U. S. 1065.] Motion of the Solicitor General to permit the Securities and Exchange Commission to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted, and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Appellant also allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
